card.name: Document cross-references and section headings
card.fires_on: Small words and word endings in cross-references to other label sections, such as 'end of', 'found in General', 'refer to', and partway through 'Precautions' or 'Pharmacology' before a section number. Also 'General' opening a dosing section heading.

modes.label: Pointing to another section
modes.description: Linking word or word ending just before a named section or a bracketed section number.

modes.label: General dosing heading
modes.description: The word General starting a heading such as General Dosing Recommendations.

modes.label: Of or to in document references
modes.description: The word of or to in phrases about where text appears in the document.
modes.example: The complete text of the Medication Guide is reprinted at the end<< of>> this document.

card.plain: It fires on the small words and word parts in label cross-references like 'see Warnings and Precautions' or 'General Dosing'.
